kv_geometry._comment: Hybrid-attention KV geometry on the profiled Qwen3-8B kernels: 9 of 36 layers keep a full KV cache, the other 27 hold at most a 256-token window (sliding-window / linear-state proxy).  At a 1250-token prompt that is 40% of the full-attention KV (74 MB against 184 MB per request), which raises the producer's push capacity from 1.41 to 3.49 req/s.

_profile_model_comment: Kernels come from the profiled Qwen3-8B bundle; only the KV geometry differs.  See tests/make_hetero_cluster.py --model.
